Razorfen Kraul runs at Dustwallow arrival (to-dustwallow, cal >= 34). Razorfen Downs runs later at Thunder Bluff forever-extras-dustwallow (cal >= 37). They do not share afterStepId.

Scholomance pickups ride the existing Bulwark/WPL/LHC key-chain steps around 53; the run is the first Undercity step at >= 57 (h4060:mount-hyjal:t97001). Key mold/Gadgetzan/Un'Goro/Araj steps are not on the route after WPL, so 5511 is dropped — enter with a lockpicker or a keyed group.
